subject: website
name: Rocket Sweep
summary: Rocket Sweep, a tool for Rocket Pool node operators, open source (MIT). It is not Level 3: when it opens, its wallet library loads WalletConnect's hidden verify frame, third-party code the user has not asked for. Chain data comes from an Alchemy key built into the bundle and Cloudflare's Ethereum endpoint.

connections.name: WalletConnect verify frame and wallet list
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.
